entries.titleZh: 在「首页」总览活跃度热力图、已关联设备，并快捷启动智能体、助理、小应用与技能
entries.titleEn: Review your activity heatmap and connected devices on Home, with quick actions for Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, and Skills
entries.reasonZh: 「在「首页」总览活跃度热力图、已关联设备，并快捷启动智能体、助理、小应用与技能」需要结合你在首页卡片上的实时浏览与点选目标来完成操作；智能体可为你直接打开首页，方便你查看概览或点击对应模块。
entries.reasonEn: “Review your activity heatmap and connected devices on Home, with quick actions for Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, and Skills” depends on what you want to inspect or launch from the live Home dashboard; the Agent opens Home directly so you can act in place.

entries.titleZh: 用全局搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）跨项目检索消息、文件、功能与设置，或输入 > 运行命令
entries.titleEn: Search across messages, sessions, files, features, and settings with ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or type > to run commands
entries.reasonZh: 「用全局搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）跨项目检索消息、文件、功能与设置，或输入 > 运行命令」需要你输入关键词并在实时匹配的会话、文件或命令结果中挑选目标；智能体也可通过内置控制工具直接帮你跳转到明确的功能或设置页。
entries.reasonEn: “Search across messages, sessions, files, features, and settings with ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or type > to run commands” lets you type queries and pick from live session, file, action, and settings matches; you can also ask the Agent to open a specific page directly.

entries.titleZh: 在双栏工作台中并排查看会话与代码/终端，拖拽移动标签页或使用分屏快捷键
entries.titleEn: Work side by side in the split workbench with draggable tabs, pane maximize, and canvas overview shortcuts
entries.reasonZh: 分栏比例、标签拖拽位置与面板焦点属于窗口视觉布局交互，由你在顶部标签栏与分割线上直接拖拽或按键完成。
entries.reasonEn: Pane sizing, tab drag-and-drop placement, and split focus are visual layout interactions controlled directly via the tab bar, splitter, or keyboard shortcuts.

entries.titleZh: 自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标
entries.titleEn: Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts
entries.reasonZh: 「自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标」属于当前窗口的个性化导航偏好，可在外观设置的「左侧导航栏」分区中按个人习惯勾选和调整顺序。
entries.reasonEn: “Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts” is a personal navigation preference configured interactively in Appearance settings under Left sidebar or from Mini App menus.

entries.titleZh: 一键切换到轻量「悬浮窗模式」，在其他应用上方随时发起对话或恢复主窗口
entries.titleEn: Switch into compact Floating window mode to chat alongside other desktop apps and restore the main window anytime
entries.reasonZh: 「一键切换到轻量「悬浮窗模式」，在其他应用上方随时发起对话或恢复主窗口」涉及本机桌面窗口形态与屏幕位置切换，需由你在左下角菜单中手动开启或点恢复按钮回到主窗口。
entries.reasonEn: “Switch into compact Floating window mode to chat alongside other desktop apps and restore the main window anytime” changes the local desktop window geometry and focus, so you trigger it from the bottom-left menu and restore the full window when ready.

entries.titleZh: 筛选、重命名、复制、从任意轮次分叉（Fork）、归档恢复与导出会话记录
entries.titleEn: Filter, rename, duplicate, fork from any turn, archive, restore, and export sessions
entries.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖选中的会话、分叉轮次或删除确认；智能体可准确打开会话界面，由你挑选目标会话或历史节点。
entries.reasonEn: These actions depend on the selected session, chosen turn to fork from, or deletion confirmation; the Agent opens the session UI so you can pick the exact target.

entries.titleZh: 按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式
entries.titleEn: Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session
entries.reasonZh: 「按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式」与你当前正在编辑的会话状态紧密相关；智能体可为你打开当前会话入口，方便你在输入框栏直观挑选模式与模型。
entries.reasonEn: “Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session” is tied to the live session composer where you can pick modes, models, reasoning effort, and approval posture interactively.

entries.titleZh: 在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、目录、历史会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令
entries.titleEn: Attach files, folders, past sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $
entries.reasonZh: 「在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、目录、历史会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令」是在撰写消息时的实时上下文拼装与命令补全交互，由你在当前聊天输入框中点选确认后一并发送。
entries.reasonEn: “Attach files, folders, past sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $” is an interactive composer workflow where you pick context chips and slash commands while drafting your prompt.

entries.titleZh: 在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务
entries.titleEn: Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode
entries.reasonZh: “在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务”需要用户在当前输入框选择服务并编辑草稿，没有可直接完成该交互的结构化 Command。也可通过工具名称或描述搜索所属服务；工具不会单独列出。目录按当前主机、工作区和模式过滤；Minimal 隐藏 MCP 入口。远程工作区暂不支持此选择器，Peer Host 必须协商 chat_mcp_catalog_v1 能力。
entries.reasonEn: “Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode” requires the user to select a server and edit the current composer draft; no structured Command completes that interaction directly. Tool names and descriptions can find their owning server without separate tool rows. The catalog is scoped to the current host, workspace, and mode; Minimal hides MCP. Remote workspaces are unsupported; Peer Hosts must advertise chat_mcp_catalog_v1.

entries.titleZh: 划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」
entries.titleEn: Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question
entries.reasonZh: 「划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」」依赖你在会话消息中划选的具体段落与批注内容，开启文本选择工具栏后选中文字即可直接触发。
entries.reasonEn: “Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question” starts from highlighting specific text in the conversation transcript and writing your note or side question in place.

entries.titleZh: 在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次
entries.titleEn: Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns
entries.reasonZh: 「在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次」取决于当前会话正处于思考、工具执行还是中断状态，你可在聊天输入框与队列条上直接操作。
entries.reasonEn: “Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns” depends on the live execution state of the active turn and is controlled directly from the chat composer and pending queue bar.

entries.titleZh: 审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝
entries.titleEn: Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback
entries.reasonZh: 「审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝」是保障你环境安全的人工审批边界，必须由你在桌面端或远控端亲自确认，智能体绝不会替你点同意。
entries.reasonEn: “Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback” is an explicit human safety boundary that you confirm in the session or from a remote controller; the Agent never self-approves.

entries.titleZh: 在会话顶部目标条随时修改目标描述或清除当前目标
entries.titleEn: Edit the active goal objective or clear the session goal from the goal banner
entries.reasonZh: 目标工具只负责读取、创建和受约束的状态转换；修改目标文本与清除目标在当前会话顶部目标栏中由你直接确认完成。
entries.reasonEn: Goal tools cover discovery, creation, and guarded status transitions; editing objective text or clearing the goal is done directly in the session goal banner.

entries.titleZh: 用 /btw（或 Ctrl+Alt+B）随手发起临时「侧问」，以及在代码编辑器中使用内联 AI
entries.titleEn: Ask quick ephemeral side questions with /btw (or Ctrl+Alt+B) and invoke inline AI inside the code editor
entries.reasonZh: 「用 /btw（或 Ctrl+Alt+B）随手发起临时「侧问」，以及在代码编辑器中使用内联 AI」是在你当前阅读或编码位置即开即用的轻量交互，可随时发起或按取消键中止。
entries.reasonEn: “Ask quick ephemeral side questions with /btw (or Ctrl+Alt+B) and invoke inline AI inside the code editor” is an on-the-spot lightweight interaction launched from your active chat composer or editor cursor and cancellable anytime.

entries.titleZh: 展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令
entries.titleEn: Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands
entries.reasonZh: 「展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令」与会话中实时滚动的工具卡片和后台进程状态绑定，可直接在对话流中点开查看或控制。
entries.reasonEn: “Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands” is bound to live tool cards and background process activity inside the active conversation stream.

entries.titleZh: 点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率
entries.titleEn: Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits
entries.reasonZh: 「点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率」在当前会话状态栏按需估算并展开展示，点击分类即可预览具体注入的上下文片段。
entries.reasonEn: “Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits” is computed on demand from the session status bar so you can inspect and preview each context category interactively.

entries.titleZh: 用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆
entries.titleEn: Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory
entries.reasonZh: 「用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆」涵盖多个针对当前会话上下文与记忆库的交互动作，可通过聊天斜杠命令或会话与记忆设置执行。
entries.reasonEn: “Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory” combines session slash commands and memory maintenance controls that you trigger in chat or Sessions & Memory settings.

entries.titleZh: 从项目或会话右键菜单一键打开本机会话存储目录，方便手动备份或排查
entries.titleEn: Reveal the local session storage folder from workspace or session menus for backup and troubleshooting
entries.reasonZh: 需要用户选择工作区或会话，并在本机桌面文件管理器中操作；远程工作区打开本机保存的会话镜像，对端设备和 Detached Dispatch 会话不支持此操作。打开目录不会修改会话归属。
entries.reasonEn: The user selects a workspace or session and works in the local desktop file manager; remote workspaces reveal their locally stored session mirror, while peer and detached-dispatch sessions are unsupported. Opening storage does not change session ownership.

entries.titleZh: 按内置、个人、项目与外部来源分类浏览当前环境可用的全部智能体
entries.titleEn: Browse built-in, personal, project, and external agents available in the current environment
entries.reasonZh: 「按内置、个人、项目与外部来源分类浏览当前环境可用的全部智能体」需要结合当前主机与工作区的实时目录进行筛选查看；智能体可为你直接打开智能体管理中心。
entries.reasonEn: “Browse built-in, personal, project, and external agents available in the current environment” displays live agent catalogs scoped to your active host and workspace; the Agent opens the Agents gallery directly for you.

entries.titleZh: 创建自定义主对话智能体，设定专属名称、职责说明与系统提示词
entries.titleEn: Create custom primary agents with their own name, description, and role instructions
entries.reasonZh: 「创建自定义主对话智能体，设定专属名称、职责说明与系统提示词」包含角色提示词编写与工具边界挑选，打开创建弹窗后即可按向导保存。
entries.reasonEn: “Create custom primary agents with their own name, description, and role instructions” lets you author role instructions and pick allowed capabilities in the creation dialog.

entries.titleZh: 查看详情、随时微调提示词、热重载配置或删除不再需要的自定义智能体
entries.titleEn: Inspect, edit instructions, hot-reload, or remove custom agents anytime
entries.reasonZh: 「查看详情、随时微调提示词、热重载配置或删除不再需要的自定义智能体」需要选定目标自定义智能体并确认编辑或删除动作，智能体会为你打开管理界面。
entries.reasonEn: “Inspect, edit instructions, hot-reload, or remove custom agents anytime” targets the specific custom agent you select for editing, reloading, or removal in the Agents view.

entries.titleZh: 创建与维护可被主智能体自动委派的个人级或项目级子智能体
entries.titleEn: Create and configure personal or project-scoped subagents that primary agents can delegate to
entries.reasonZh: 「创建与维护可被主智能体自动委派的个人级或项目级子智能体」涉及作用域选择（个人或当前项目）、提示词与模型配置，可在智能体页或项目资源页中直观完成。
entries.reasonEn: “Create and configure personal or project-scoped subagents that primary agents can delegate to” lets you choose personal or project scope, craft specialist instructions, and configure subagent behavior in the UI.

entries.titleZh: 悬停或点开智能体卡片，透视它的可用工具清单、Skills 与只读安全限制
entries.titleEn: Inspect each agent’s enabled tools, Skills, and read-only safety posture at a glance
entries.reasonZh: 「悬停或点开智能体卡片，透视它的可用工具清单、Skills 与只读安全限制」用于在界面上直观核对不同角色的能力边界与安全约束。
entries.reasonEn: “Inspect each agent’s enabled tools, Skills, and read-only safety posture at a glance” surfaces per-role capability summaries and read-only boundaries interactively in the Agents gallery.

entries.titleZh: 按智能体精细开关工具组、单个工具与 Skills，并随时一键恢复默认配置
entries.titleEn: Toggle tool groups, individual tools, and Skills per agent — with one-click reset to defaults
entries.reasonZh: 「按智能体精细开关工具组、单个工具与 Skills，并随时一键恢复默认配置」需要针对具体角色在工具组与技能组选择器中勾选确认，智能体会为你打开对应配置界面。
entries.reasonEn: “Toggle tool groups, individual tools, and Skills per agent — with one-click reset to defaults” uses interactive tool-group and skill-group pickers per agent profile so you can review and reset selections safely.

entries.titleZh: 在助理空间一览全部个人助理、查看人设与能力摘要，并一键创建新助理
entries.titleEn: Browse all your personal assistants, review their persona and capability summaries, and create new ones in one click
entries.reasonZh: 「在助理空间一览全部个人助理、查看人设与能力摘要，并一键创建新助理」需要你在助理空间中浏览卡片并确认新建或进入哪个助理；智能体可为你直接打开助理空间。
entries.reasonEn: “Browse all your personal assistants, review their persona and capability summaries, and create new ones in one click” opens the Assistant gallery where you can browse existing companions, create a new one, or jump into its configuration.

entries.titleZh: 把暂时不用的助理从侧边栏收起（完整保留人设与历史），需要时随时重新打开
entries.titleEn: Hide inactive assistants from the sidebar while keeping their persona and history intact, and reopen them anytime
entries.reasonZh: 关闭操作依赖用户选择的助理；助理空间保留完整目录，并提供重新打开入口。
entries.reasonEn: Closing depends on the assistant selected by the user; the gallery retains the complete catalog and provides a reopen action.

entries.titleZh: 将最常用的伙伴设为「主助理」、删除不再需要的副助理，或一键重置为初始状态
entries.titleEn: Designate your Primary Assistant, remove extra assistants, or reset an assistant workspace back to defaults
entries.reasonZh: 「将最常用的伙伴设为「主助理」、删除不再需要的副助理，或一键重置为初始状态」涉及影响长期记忆与历史记录的确认动作，由你在助理详情菜单中核对后执行。
entries.reasonEn: “Designate your Primary Assistant, remove extra assistants, or reset an assistant workspace back to defaults” includes destructive reset and deletion confirmations that remain safely under your explicit control in the UI.

entries.titleZh: 定制助理昵称、角色设定与说话气质，并挑选官方插画头像、Emoji 或自定义字符
entries.titleEn: Edit an assistant’s name, role archetype, and conversational vibe, and pick a preset avatar, emoji, or custom glyph
entries.reasonZh: 「定制助理昵称、角色设定与说话气质，并挑选官方插画头像、Emoji 或自定义字符」属于可视化的形象与气质编辑流程，可在助理配置页边改边看实时效果。
entries.reasonEn: “Edit an assistant’s name, role archetype, and conversational vibe, and pick a preset avatar, emoji, or custom glyph” is a visual customization flow on the assistant detail page with live avatar preview.

entries.titleZh: 直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节
entries.titleEn: Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown
entries.reasonZh: 「直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节」需要你在助理配置页的文档编辑器中审阅与撰写人设正文，所有改动会自动同步保存。
entries.reasonEn: “Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown” provides an interactive Markdown editor with frontmatter synchronization right inside the assistant configuration page.

entries.titleZh: 从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话
entries.titleEn: Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page
entries.reasonZh: 「从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话」结合了快速输入草稿与历史会话点选，智能体可为你打开该助理主页以便立即开始。
entries.reasonEn: “Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page” combines a quick message composer and session history list on the assistant’s detail view.

entries.titleZh: 为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务
entries.titleEn: Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant
entries.reasonZh: 「为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务」需要你在当前助理的定时任务区设定时间、提示词与启用状态，智能体也可通过定时工具协助管理。
entries.reasonEn: “Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant” lets you review, add, pause, or edit scheduled prompts scoped specifically to the selected assistant workspace.

entries.titleZh: 在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能
entries.titleEn: Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills
entries.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能」需要针对你选定的具体项目工作区读取并保存覆盖项与权限规则；可在侧边栏项目行点击「项目资源」图标直接进入。
entries.reasonEn: “Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills” applies to a chosen project workspace and its live host catalogs; open Project Resources from the project row in the sidebar to edit them in one place.

entries.titleZh: 在多个已打开项目间自由切换、拖拽排序或关闭闲置工作区
entries.titleEn: Switch, drag to reorder, or close open project workspaces in the sidebar
entries.reasonZh: 排序与关闭哪个工作区取决于你在侧边栏的实时选择；智能体可帮你打开项目入口，不会擅自关闭你正在使用的工作区。
entries.reasonEn: Reordering or closing workspaces depends on your live sidebar selection; the Agent can open the project flow without closing active work behind your back.

entries.titleZh: 查看最近打开过的项目列表，一键重开或清理失效记录
entries.titleEn: Browse recently opened projects, reopen them in one click, or clean up stale entries
entries.reasonZh: 「查看最近打开过的项目列表，一键重开或清理失效记录」需要你从历史项目列表中确认要重开或清理的条目；智能体会为你打开对应入口并在界面中完成选择。
entries.reasonEn: “Browse recently opened projects, reopen them in one click, or clean up stale entries” lets you inspect your recent history list and confirm which project to reopen or remove in the UI.

entries.titleZh: 添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件
entries.titleEn: Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files
entries.reasonZh: 「添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件」涉及目录选择器、关联说明编辑及移除确认；智能体可带你定位项目入口，由你在界面中确认目录变更。
entries.reasonEn: “Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files” involves folder pickers, descriptions, and unlink confirmation in Project Resources so your directory bindings stay intentional.

entries.titleZh: 定制项目专属图标图案、配色或分别上传浅色/深色自定义图片
entries.titleEn: Customize project icons with presets and colors, or upload separate light and dark images
entries.reasonZh: 点击项目资源页的大图标，从工作学习或生活兴趣分类选择图案及颜色，或分别上传浅色、深色图片，预览后保存到工作区所属主机。
entries.reasonEn: Click the large icon on the Project resources page to choose a work/study or life/hobby icon and color, or upload separate light and dark images, preview them, then save on the workspace host.

entries.titleZh: 自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复
entries.titleEn: Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it
entries.reasonZh: 「自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复」由工作区生命周期自动维护，当你需要排查监听状态或手动重启监听时可在界面中查看与触发。
entries.reasonEn: “Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it” runs automatically with your workspace lifecycle and exposes live watcher status and retry controls when troubleshooting large repos.

entries.titleZh: 在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位
entries.titleEn: Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content
entries.reasonZh: 「在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位」面向你在文件面板与全局搜索中的实时交互检索；若你直接向智能体提问，智能体也会用内置搜索工具自行查找代码。
entries.reasonEn: “Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content” powers interactive search in the file panel and Global Search while the Agent also searches your codebase directly during tasks.

entries.titleZh: 直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区
entries.titleEn: Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard
entries.reasonZh: 「直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区」需要选择连接主机、完成认证并在远端目录浏览器中选定文件夹；智能体可打开新建项目向导供你完成连接。
entries.reasonEn: “Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard” walks through host selection, authentication, and remote folder picking in the New Project dialog after the Agent opens it.

entries.titleZh: 在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度
entries.titleEn: Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health
entries.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度」汇总了当前工作区、连接与应用运行时的实时指标，可在项目资源页和状态界面直观查看。
entries.reasonEn: “Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health” aggregates live workspace, Git, and application health metrics for visual inspection in Project Resources and app status views.

entries.titleZh: 按单次操作、单个文件或整个会话一键「接受」或「拒绝」智能体产生的代码改动
entries.titleEn: Accept or reject AI code changes by individual operation, file, or entire session
entries.reasonZh: 「按单次操作、单个文件或整个会话一键「接受」或「拒绝」智能体产生的代码改动」需要你在审阅具体 Diff 后做出保留或还原的判断，可在会话修改栏与差异视图中直接点击完成。
entries.reasonEn: “Accept or reject AI code changes by individual operation, file, or entire session” lets you review the concrete diff first and confirm which edits to keep or revert in the diff viewer and modified-files bar.

entries.titleZh: 基于自动变更快照查看文件修改轨迹，随时把会话与代码一起回滚到指定历史轮次
entries.titleEn: Browse automatic file-change snapshots and roll back a session and its files to any earlier turn
entries.reasonZh: 「基于自动变更快照查看文件修改轨迹，随时把会话与代码一起回滚到指定历史轮次」会同时回退工作区文件内容与对话时间线，需要你在会话轮次上明确选择回滚节点并确认。
entries.reasonEn: “Browse automatic file-change snapshots and roll back a session and its files to any earlier turn” rewinds workspace files alongside the conversation timeline, so you explicitly choose and confirm the target turn in the UI.

entries.titleZh: 原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅
entries.titleEn: Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink
entries.reasonZh: 「原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅」面向文档阅读、排版编译与画布坐标批注等视觉交互，在工作区打开对应格式文件即可自动启用专属视图。
entries.reasonEn: “Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink” activates format-aware visual editors and annotation layers automatically whenever you open Markdown, plan, LaTeX, or PDF files.

entries.titleZh: 启用本地工作区加速搜索索引，实现毫秒级大仓库内容检索
entries.titleEn: Maintain accelerated local workspace search indexes for instant large-repo lookups
entries.reasonZh: Glob/Grep 可直接完成智能体搜索，而界面搜索索引的启停状态归属工作区搜索设置管理。
entries.reasonEn: Glob and Grep provide direct agent search, while UI search-index lifecycle is managed through workspace search settings.

entries.titleZh: 仅在当前语言提供器实际支持时显示格式化、定义与类型跳转、引用、重命名、快速修复和符号导航
entries.titleEn: Show formatting, definition and type navigation, references, rename, quick fixes, and symbol navigation only when supported by the active language provider
entries.reasonZh: 「仅在当前语言提供器实际支持时显示格式化、定义与类型跳转、引用、重命名、快速修复和符号导航」与你在编辑器中聚焦的文件类型和光标所在符号位置绑定，可在代码编辑器右键菜单或快捷键中直接调用。
entries.reasonEn: “Show formatting, definition and type navigation, references, rename, quick fixes, and symbol navigation only when supported by the active language provider” depends on the focused file type and cursor symbol in the code editor, surfaced through context menus and breadcrumbs.

entries.titleZh: 在本地桌面会话中直接粘贴剪贴板截图，或把本机文件与文件夹拖进聊天框
entries.titleEn: Paste clipboard images or drag local files and folders straight into Desktop sessions
entries.reasonZh: 该流程需要用户选择或提供本地附件；智能体可读取已经进入会话的文件，但不会自行声称完成了用户侧拖放或剪贴板选择。
entries.reasonEn: This flow requires the user to select or provide local attachments; the Agent can read files already in context without pretending it performed the user's drag, drop, or clipboard selection.

entries.titleZh: 在 Finder 或系统资源管理器中一键定位当前本机文件或文件夹
entries.titleEn: Reveal any local file or folder directly in Finder or your OS file manager
entries.reasonZh: 这是控制器本机的界面动作，且远程工作区路径不能回退到本机打开；智能体会打开文件入口，不会把目标机路径静默交给控制器系统。
entries.reasonEn: This is a controller-local UI action, and remote-workspace paths must never fall back to the local file manager; the Agent opens the file surface without silently reusing a target-host path locally.

entries.titleZh: 按「我的 / 智能体」分类查看、切换终端，或保存常用的终端启动配置
entries.titleEn: Browse and switch terminals across Mine and Agent views, and save reusable terminal configurations
entries.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖当前终端会话列表和活动面板；智能体可直接新建终端，并可用终端工具执行任务，而多会话切换与配置管理保留在界面中完成。
entries.reasonEn: These actions depend on the live terminal-session list and active panel; the Agent can create terminals and run commands via tools while multi-session management stays in the UI.

entries.titleZh: 自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型
entries.titleEn: Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell
entries.reasonZh: 「自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型」需要读取当前主机实际安装的 Shell 列表并由你挑选目标类型，可在终端新建菜单或终端设置中完成。
entries.reasonEn: “Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell” queries the shells installed on your host so you can choose one from the New Terminal menu or Terminal settings.

entries.titleZh: 在底部面板与右侧分栏间流畅拖拽调整终端尺寸，自动适配全屏 TUI 与长行排版
entries.titleEn: Resize docked bottom or split-pane terminals smoothly with automatic row/column adaptation for TUI tools
entries.reasonZh: 「在底部面板与右侧分栏间流畅拖拽调整终端尺寸，自动适配全屏 TUI 与长行排版」随你在工作台中拖拽面板分割线或切换窗口大小实时自动同步，无需任何手动设置。
entries.reasonEn: “Resize docked bottom or split-pane terminals smoothly with automatic row/column adaptation for TUI tools” happens automatically as you drag panel splitters or resize the window in the workbench.

entries.titleZh: 回溯终端命令历史并识别 Shell Integration 状态
entries.titleEn: Browse terminal command history and detect Shell Integration support
entries.reasonZh: 「回溯终端命令历史并识别 Shell Integration 状态」与具体终端实例的运行缓冲和 Shell 环境相关，可在终端面板中直接翻阅查看。
entries.reasonEn: “Browse terminal command history and detect Shell Integration support” is tied to each live or exited terminal session in the terminal panel.

entries.titleZh: 区分「关标签分离视图」与「彻底停止关闭进程」，安全关停单个或全部终端
entries.titleEn: Detach views safely when closing tabs, or explicitly stop and shut down individual or all terminal processes
entries.reasonZh: 「区分「关标签分离视图」与「彻底停止关闭进程」，安全关停单个或全部终端」避免误杀正在运行的服务或未保存的终端作业，由你在终端列表菜单中明确选择停止或移除。
entries.reasonEn: “Detach views safely when closing tabs, or explicitly stop and shut down individual or all terminal processes” protects running dev servers and interactive jobs until you explicitly stop or close them from the terminal list.

entries.titleZh: 一键安装 `openbitfun` 命令行工具，并用 `doctor` 自检运行环境与配置状态
entries.titleEn: Install the `openbitfun` executable and run `openbitfun doctor` to verify environment health
entries.reasonZh: 「一键安装 `openbitfun` 命令行工具，并用 `doctor` 自检运行环境与配置状态」是在你的系统终端或内置终端中执行的命令行安装与环境巡检操作，智能体可为你打开终端方便直接运行。
entries.reasonEn: “Install the `openbitfun` executable and run `openbitfun doctor` to verify environment health” is run directly from your terminal shell; the Agent can open the terminal surface so you can run install or doctor commands.

entries.titleZh: 在交互式 TUI 中使用 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 与子智能体树检视器
entries.titleEn: Work in the interactive TUI with `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, prompt stash, and subagent tree view
entries.reasonZh: 「在交互式 TUI 中使用 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 与子智能体树检视器」是运行在终端中的全屏交互界面能力，启动 `openbitfun` 后即可通过斜杠命令与命令面板调出。
entries.reasonEn: “Work in the interactive TUI with `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, prompt stash, and subagent tree view” is an interactive full-screen terminal session launched by running `openbitfun` in your project directory.

entries.titleZh: 在空输入框按 `!` 秒进 SHELL 命令模式，或按 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴剪贴板图片与本地图片路径
entries.titleEn: Type `!` on an empty prompt for SHELL mode, or press `Ctrl+V` to attach clipboard images and local image paths
entries.reasonZh: 「在空输入框按 `!` 秒进 SHELL 命令模式，或按 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴剪贴板图片与本地图片路径」属于 TUI 输入框内的即时键盘交互，打开 `openbitfun` 聊天界面后即可直接使用。
entries.reasonEn: “Type `!` on an empty prompt for SHELL mode, or press `Ctrl+V` to attach clipboard images and local image paths” is an immediate keyboard workflow inside the interactive TUI composer.

entries.titleZh: 通过 `openbitfun chat --shared` 让多个终端窗口共享同一个工作区运行时
entries.titleEn: Reuse one workspace runtime across multiple terminal windows with `openbitfun chat --shared`
entries.reasonZh: 「通过 `openbitfun chat --shared` 让多个终端窗口共享同一个工作区运行时」需要从多个系统终端窗口启动共享客户端会话，由你在终端环境中按需开启。
entries.reasonEn: “Reuse one workspace runtime across multiple terminal windows with `openbitfun chat --shared`” is launched across your terminal windows whenever you want multi-pane TUI access to one shared runtime.

entries.titleZh: 使用 `daemon` 托管远控机器人与定时任务，用 `dispatch outbound` 远程派发，或启动 `server` 标准流服务
entries.titleEn: Host bots and Cron jobs via `daemon`, submit remote jobs with `dispatch outbound`, or run the stdio `server` host
entries.reasonZh: 「使用 `daemon` 托管远控机器人与定时任务，用 `dispatch outbound` 远程派发，或启动 `server` 标准流服务」涵盖守护进程、跨机派发与编辑器协议宿主等命令行入口，可根据部署场景在终端中直接运行对应子命令。
entries.reasonEn: “Host bots and Cron jobs via `daemon`, submit remote jobs with `dispatch outbound`, or run the stdio `server` host” provides dedicated CLI subcommands for background daemons, cross-device dispatch, and stdio JSON-RPC editor integrations.

entries.titleZh: 管理仓库信任授权，以及创建、绑定、提升、重建和清理隔离的 Git Worktree
entries.titleEn: Manage repository trust and create, bind, promote, recreate, or clean up isolated Git worktrees
entries.reasonZh: 「管理仓库信任授权，以及创建、绑定、提升、重建和清理隔离的 Git Worktree」涉及仓库安全信任确认及多会话工作树生命周期管理，可在会话工作树入口或「设置 → 工作区与 Git → Worktrees」中直观操作。
entries.reasonEn: “Manage repository trust and create, bind, promote, recreate, or clean up isolated Git worktrees” involves repository trust confirmation and worktree lifecycle choices managed in session worktree controls and Workspace & Git settings.

entries.titleZh: 读取关联 Issue 的需求背景、验收标准与讨论上下文
entries.titleEn: Load linked Issue titles, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and discussion context
entries.reasonZh: 「读取关联 Issue 的需求背景、验收标准与讨论上下文」与评审面板中选定的仓库及 Issue 编号联动，可在查看 PR 与评审详情时一并展开核对。
entries.reasonEn: “Load linked Issue titles, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and discussion context” connects to the selected repository and issue reference inside your review workflow.

entries.titleZh: 一键预览、生成或快速填充贴合改动的提交信息
entries.titleEn: Preview, generate, or quick-fill commit messages tailored to your staged changes
entries.reasonZh: 「一键预览、生成或快速填充贴合改动的提交信息」需要结合当前工作区暂存改动并在提交输入框中由你过目确认或微调文案。
entries.reasonEn: “Preview, generate, or quick-fill commit messages tailored to your staged changes” drafts a commit message from your current changes so you can review and tweak the wording before committing.

entries.titleZh: 一键检查桌面控制可用性及「辅助功能」「屏幕录制」授权状态
entries.titleEn: Check Computer Use availability plus Accessibility and Screen Recording status
entries.reasonZh: 「一键检查桌面控制可用性及「辅助功能」「屏幕录制」授权状态」会实时读取当前系统的图形会话与隐私授权状态；智能体会为你直接打开「浏览器与桌面控制」设置页核对。
entries.reasonEn: "Check Computer Use availability plus Accessibility and Screen Recording status" reads live graphical-session and OS privacy state; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings so you can review each check.

entries.titleZh: 在界面内一键触发桌面控制所需的操作系统权限申请
entries.titleEn: Request required operating-system permissions for desktop control
entries.reasonZh: 「在界面内一键触发桌面控制所需的操作系统权限申请」必须由本机用户在操作系统原生权限弹窗中亲自确认；智能体会打开授权设置入口但绝不能代你越权开启。
entries.reasonEn: "Request required operating-system permissions for desktop control" must be confirmed personally in the operating system’s native consent prompt; the Agent opens the setup page and never grants permissions itself.

entries.titleZh: 直达系统「隐私与安全性」对应设置面板
entries.titleEn: Jump straight to the matching OS Privacy & Security settings pane
entries.reasonZh: 「直达系统「隐私与安全性」对应设置面板」会唤起操作系统的外部系统设置窗口供你手动勾选开关；智能体会为你打开对应的控制设置页触发跳转。
entries.reasonEn: "Jump straight to the matching OS Privacy & Security settings pane" opens your operating system’s external Settings app for manual toggling; the Agent opens the control settings entry so you can launch it.

entries.titleZh: 自动发现本机受支持的浏览器并查看实时 CDP 连接状态
entries.titleEn: Discover installed supported browsers and inspect live CDP connection status
entries.reasonZh: 「自动发现本机受支持的浏览器并查看实时 CDP 连接状态」依赖实时扫描本机浏览器进程与调试端口状态；智能体会打开设置页展示当前检测到的浏览器列表。
entries.reasonEn: "Discover installed supported browsers and inspect live CDP connection status" scans local browser installations and live debugging ports; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings to display the detected list.

entries.titleZh: 启动受控浏览器，或随时连接 / 断开已开启 CDP 的浏览器
entries.titleEn: Launch browser control, or connect to and disconnect from a CDP-enabled browser
entries.reasonZh: 「启动受控浏览器，或随时连接 / 断开已开启 CDP 的浏览器」涉及你日常浏览器的连接授权与会话切换；智能体会为你打开「浏览器与桌面控制」页面由你点击连接或断开。
entries.reasonEn: "Launch browser control, or connect to and disconnect from a CDP-enabled browser" controls live access to your personal browser session; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings so you can connect or disconnect explicitly.

entries.titleZh: 一键配置默认 CDP 远程调试参数并按需优雅重启浏览器
entries.titleEn: Enable default CDP debugging setup and restart the browser when needed
entries.reasonZh: 「一键配置默认 CDP 远程调试参数并按需优雅重启浏览器」重启浏览器可能影响你当前打开的网页标签，必须由你在界面确认后执行；智能体会打开对应设置入口。
entries.reasonEn: "Enable default CDP debugging setup and restart the browser when needed" restarting your browser affects open tabs and requires your explicit confirmation; the Agent opens the setup panel so you decide when to restart.

entries.titleZh: 在会话控制卡片中实时查看当前受控目标、模式与授权画面预览
entries.titleEn: Watch the current target, control mode, and live capture preview in the session card
entries.reasonZh: 「在会话控制卡片中实时查看当前受控目标、模式与授权画面预览」需要当前存在活动的桌面控制会话并在界面展开控制卡片查看（预览仅限已授权目标与虚拟指针，远程设备不会回退截取控制端本机画面）。
entries.reasonEn: "Watch the current target, control mode, and live capture preview in the session card" requires an active control session and expanding the live card in chat (the preview shows only the authorized target and virtual pointer, without local fallback on remote hosts).

entries.titleZh: 按单个 App 窗口精细共享，先确认画面再独立授权键鼠控制
entries.titleEn: Share an individual App window and grant or revoke input control separately
entries.reasonZh: 共享窗口及控制模式由用户明确选择；智能体只能请求共享，不能代替用户授权。
entries.reasonEn: Window selection and input mode require an explicit user choice; agents can request sharing but cannot grant themselves control.

entries.titleZh: 直接在共享预览画面中点击、拖拽、滚动与输入交互
entries.titleEn: Click, drag, scroll, and type directly through the authorized shared preview
entries.reasonZh: 预览输入需要用户授权，并绑定共享窗口、图像坐标及授权版本。
entries.reasonEn: Preview input requires user authorization and is bound to the shared window, image coordinates and authorization revision.

entries.titleZh: 按应用可执行文件与控制模式记住常用授权，或随时撤销记忆
entries.titleEn: Remember or revoke control grants per application executable and input mode
entries.reasonZh: 记住授权只在用户选定并共享同一应用后生效，应用文件或输入模式改变时需要重新授权。

entries.titleEn: Review configuration conflicts, security impact, and source-control snapshots before importing
entries.reasonZh: “在导入前集中审查配置冲突、执行安全影响与来源控制快照”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
entries.reasonEn: “Review configuration conflicts, security impact, and source-control snapshots before importing” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

entries.titleZh: 在系统文件管理器或远程环境中直接定位外部配置文件来源路径
entries.titleEn: Reveal external configuration source files in your file manager or remote environment
entries.reasonZh: “在系统文件管理器或远程环境中直接定位外部配置文件来源路径”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
entries.reasonEn: “Reveal external configuration source files in your file manager or remote environment” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

entries.titleZh: 保存、测试与管理常用 SSH 连接配置
entries.titleEn: Save, test, and manage reusable SSH connection profiles
entries.reasonZh: 「保存、测试与管理常用 SSH 连接配置」涉及填写主机参数、连通性探测与删除确认；智能体会为你打开连接配置界面，由你核对并保存目标主机。
entries.reasonEn: "Save, test, and manage reusable SSH connection profiles" involves editing host parameters, running live connectivity checks, and confirming removals; the Agent opens the connection setup dialog so you can review and save the host.

entries.titleZh: 支持密码、私钥、证书、~/.ssh/config 与跳板机登录
entries.titleEn: Authenticate via passwords, keys, certificates, ~/.ssh/config, and jump hosts
entries.reasonZh: SSH 密码、私钥与证书属于秘密输入，必须由用户通过受保护的凭据入口提供；智能体不会读取或回显这些秘密。
entries.reasonEn: SSH passwords, private keys, and certificates are secret inputs that must enter through the protected credential flow; the Agent neither reads nor echoes them.

entries.titleZh: 自动发现远程 Docker 容器并进入容器内开发
entries.titleEn: Discover remote Docker containers and work directly inside a container
entries.reasonZh: 「自动发现远程 Docker 容器并进入容器内开发」需要先连接宿主机并从实时容器列表中选择目标环境；智能体可打开远程项目向导，由你选定容器与目录。
entries.reasonEn: "Discover remote Docker containers and work directly inside a container" requires connecting to the host and picking from live running containers; the Agent opens the remote project wizard so you can select the container and folder.

entries.titleZh: 在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区
entries.titleEn: Open a Windows WSL distribution directly as a Linux workspace
entries.reasonZh: 「在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区」需要读取当前 Windows 主机的发行版列表并由你选定 Linux 用户与工作目录；智能体会打开连接配置入口供你选择。
entries.reasonEn: "Open a Windows WSL distribution directly as a Linux workspace" requires listing distributions on the Windows host and choosing a Linux user and directory; the Agent opens the connection dialog so you can pick them.

entries.titleZh: 打开、关闭或移除远程工作区并查看远端系统信息
entries.titleEn: Open, close, or remove remote workspaces and inspect host details
entries.reasonZh: 「打开、关闭或移除远程工作区并查看远端系统信息」依赖当前已连接主机与你在目录浏览器中选定的路径；智能体会打开对应入口，由你确认要打开或移除的远程项目。
entries.reasonEn: "Open, close, or remove remote workspaces and inspect host details" depends on the active host connection and folder selection; the Agent opens the workspace flow so you can confirm which remote project to open or remove.

entries.titleZh: 在本机与远端之间上传、下载文件或压缩包并可随时取消
entries.titleEn: Upload and download files or archives between local and remote hosts
entries.reasonZh: 「在本机与远端之间上传、下载文件或压缩包并可随时取消」需要你在本机与远端目录之间选择源文件及保存路径，并跟踪实时传输进度；智能体会打开文件面板交由你确认操作。
entries.reasonEn: "Upload and download files or archives between local and remote hosts" requires picking local and remote paths and monitoring live transfer progress; the Agent opens the file surface so you can confirm the transfer.

entries.titleZh: 查看实时 SSH 连接状态，按需断开单个或全部连接
entries.titleEn: Monitor live SSH connection state and disconnect one or all sessions
entries.reasonZh: 「查看实时 SSH 连接状态，按需断开单个或全部连接」会改变当前已打开远程工作区的在线状态，需根据实时连接列表确认断开范围；智能体会打开连接状态入口供你操作。
entries.reasonEn: "Monitor live SSH connection state and disconnect one or all sessions" affects live remote workspaces and requires choosing which active connection to close; the Agent opens the connection control entry for confirmation.

entries.titleZh: 本机可被控制
entries.titleEn: Allow control of this device
entries.reasonZh: 请在当前设备的「设备与连接」概览中切换「本机可被控制」，选择其他设备能否连接这台设备。
entries.reasonEn: Choose “Allow control of this device” in the local Devices & Connections overview to set whether other devices can connect to this one.

entries.titleZh: 使用免部署官方 Relay 或桌面端局域网 Relay（可同时开启）
entries.titleEn: Use the zero-setup official Relay or Desktop LAN Relay concurrently
entries.reasonZh: 「使用免部署官方 Relay 或桌面端局域网 Relay（可同时开启）」需要结合你当前的网络环境确认连接入口；官方 Relay 开箱即用，私有 Relay 仅面向配套定制客户端构建，界面不提供自定义服务器地址输入。
entries.reasonEn: "Use the zero-setup official Relay or Desktop LAN Relay concurrently" depends on your current network setup and host confirmation; the official Relay needs no deployment, while private Relays require matching custom builds rather than a custom URL field.

entries.titleZh: 查看本机局域网地址、网络网卡状态与扫码邀请链接
entries.titleEn: Inspect LAN IP addresses, network interfaces, and shareable QR invitations
entries.reasonZh: 「查看本机局域网地址、网络网卡状态与扫码邀请链接」涉及查看本机实时网卡地址与屏幕上展示邀请二维码供手机扫描；智能体会为你直接打开「设备与连接」中的「手机或浏览器」连接面板。
entries.reasonEn: "Inspect LAN IP addresses, network interfaces, and shareable QR invitations" involves inspecting live network interfaces and displaying a visual QR invitation for your phone; the Agent opens the Phone or browser panel in Devices & Connections directly for you.

entries.titleZh: 通过 GitHub 或邮箱验证码登录账号并查看身份状态
entries.titleEn: Sign in with GitHub or an email verification code and check account status
entries.reasonZh: 登录必须由用户在外部认证页面完成。GitHub 与邮箱是独立账号，各设备需使用同一种方式和同一账号；旧客户端或服务可能仅支持 GitHub。智能体可打开入口并读取非秘密状态，不能代替用户认证。
entries.reasonEn: The user must complete sign-in on the external authentication page. GitHub and email are independent accounts; devices need the same method and account. Older clients or services may support GitHub only. The Agent may open the entry and read non-secret status, but cannot authenticate for the user.

entries.titleZh: 查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备
entries.titleEn: Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal
entries.reasonZh: 「查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备」需要核对控制端账户下的具体设备并确认别名修改或移除操作（若只想让智能体列出可用设备，可直接调用远程派发的列出目标能力）。
entries.reasonEn: "Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal" requires selecting a specific device under the controller account and confirming alias edits or removal (to simply read the device list in chat, use list-targets on Detached Dispatch).

entries.titleZh: 开启 Peer Device Mode，在当前窗口无缝接管另一台电脑的工作区
entries.titleEn: Use Peer Device Mode to operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window
entries.reasonZh: 「开启 Peer Device Mode，在当前窗口无缝接管另一台电脑的工作区」会切换当前窗口所绑定的远端主机数据面，需要你在侧边栏或设备面板明确点击目标设备确认切换。
entries.reasonEn: "Use Peer Device Mode to operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window" switches the active window’s live data plane to another host and requires an explicit device selection in the sidebar or device switcher.

entries.titleZh: 在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机
entries.titleEn: Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission
entries.reasonZh: 「在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机」需要核对目标端缺失的模型配置并由你确认跨机同步；智能体会打开派发准备入口保留可见确认。
entries.reasonEn: "Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission" requires reviewing missing model settings on the target and confirming cross-host sync; the Agent opens the dispatch preparation UI for your review.

entries.titleZh: 断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录
entries.titleEn: Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts
entries.reasonZh: 「断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录」由会话界面随重连游标自动回填与持久化同步；智能体会直接为你打开对应的派发会话视图查看完整上下文。
entries.reasonEn: "Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts" is synchronized automatically with resumable cursors in the session view; the Agent opens the dispatched session so you can inspect the full transcript.

entries.titleZh: 远程批复目标端等待中的权限请求并继续推进任务
entries.titleEn: Answer pending target-side permission requests remotely and continue work
entries.reasonZh: 「远程批复目标端等待中的权限请求并继续推进任务」需要你逐条审阅待授权的操作内容与后续补充指令；智能体会定位到该会话的审批界面交由你拍板。
entries.reasonEn: "Answer pending target-side permission requests remotely and continue work" requires your explicit review of each guarded operation and any follow-up instructions; the Agent opens the session approval prompt for your decision.

entries.titleZh: 将目标机完成的代码改动安全同步回本机工作区
entries.titleEn: Sync completed target-side code changes back to your local workspace
entries.reasonZh: 「将目标机完成的代码改动安全同步回本机工作区」涉及对比本机当前分支状态与确认合并方式；智能体会打开派发结果同步入口，确保不会意外覆盖你未保存的本地改动。
entries.reasonEn: "Sync completed target-side code changes back to your local workspace" involves checking local working-tree state and confirming how changes land; the Agent opens the result-sync flow so local edits are never overwritten.

entries.titleZh: 一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接
entries.titleEn: Create and open a shareable access link for any Page
entries.reasonZh: 「一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接」涉及在当前客户端生成带会话上下文的打开链接或复制到剪贴板；智能体会为你打开 Pages 管理页（公开链接也可直接通过列表读取）。
entries.reasonEn: "Create and open a shareable access link for any Page" generates an openable session link or copies it in the UI; the Agent opens the Pages scene so you can launch or share it directly.

entries.titleZh: 在聊天输入框一键开始、完成或取消语音听写录音
entries.titleEn: Start, finish, or cancel voice dictation right from the chat composer
entries.reasonZh: 「在聊天输入框一键开始、完成或取消语音听写录音」需要你亲自对着麦克风说话并控制录音起止；智能体会为你打开语音设置或引导使用输入框麦克风按钮。
entries.reasonEn: "Start, finish, or cancel voice dictation right from the chat composer" requires live microphone speaking and user-timed start/stop control; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can enable and use the composer mic.

entries.titleZh: 录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态
entries.titleEn: Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status
entries.reasonZh: 「录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态」随聊天输入框的实时录音会话自动工作；智能体会打开语音配置入口方便你检查麦克风与模型就绪状态。
entries.reasonEn: "Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status" runs automatically during an active composer recording; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can verify model and mic readiness.

entries.titleZh: 从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务
entries.titleEn: Switch to a client-wide realtime voice call from the Hi dock or Floating Window mode to run or stop project tasks
entries.reasonZh: 「从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务」依赖实时麦克风收音、双向音频流与你的口头指令；智能体会打开对应入口并将通话控制与任务进展保留在可见界面。
entries.reasonEn: "Switch to a client-wide realtime voice call from the Hi dock or Floating Window mode to run or stop project tasks" depends on live microphone input, streaming audio playback, and spoken commands; the Agent opens the voice setup and keeps call controls visible.

entries.titleZh: 在「宠物与助手」页配置实时语音开关、火山引擎 API Key 与音色角色
entries.titleEn: Configure the realtime voice assistant toggle, Volcengine API Key, and voice persona
entries.reasonZh: 「在「宠物与助手」页配置实时语音开关、火山引擎 API Key 与音色角色」包含私密 API Key 凭据与音色选择，必须由你在设置界面亲自填写，不会经过大模型上下文。
entries.reasonEn: "Configure the realtime voice assistant toggle, Volcengine API Key, and voice persona" includes private API Key credentials and voice selection that you enter directly in Settings outside model context.

entries.titleZh: 浏览、下载、校验、修复或清理 SenseVoice 与 Qwen3-ASR 本机离线语音模型
entries.titleEn: Browse, download, verify, repair, or delete local SenseVoice and Qwen3-ASR speech models
entries.reasonZh: 「浏览、下载、校验、修复或清理 SenseVoice 与 Qwen3-ASR 本机离线语音模型」涉及磁盘空间占用、模型下载进度与删除确认；智能体会为你打开「输入与交互 → 语音」设置页操作。
entries.reasonEn: "Browse, download, verify, repair, or delete local SenseVoice and Qwen3-ASR speech models" involves disk space, live download progress, and deletion confirmation; the Agent opens Input & Interaction → Voice settings for you.

entries.titleZh: 随时取消正在下载中的本地语音模型任务
entries.titleEn: Cancel an in-progress local speech-model download anytime
entries.reasonZh: 「随时取消正在下载中的本地语音模型任务」仅在模型下载进行中触发；智能体会打开语音模型管理页供你查看实时进度或点击取消。
entries.reasonEn: "Cancel an in-progress local speech-model download anytime" applies while a model download is actively running; the Agent opens the Voice settings section where you can cancel it.

entries.titleZh: 选择「自动」或指定识别语言，并切换当前使用的系统麦克风
entries.titleEn: Choose Auto or an explicit recognition language and pick your active system microphone
entries.reasonZh: 「选择「自动」或指定识别语言，并切换当前使用的系统麦克风」需要结合你当前插拔的音频输入硬件与口述语种偏好在界面点选；智能体会打开语音设置供你切换。
entries.reasonEn: "Choose Auto or an explicit recognition language and pick your active system microphone" depends on your connected audio hardware and language preference; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can pick the right mic and language.

entries.titleZh: 在设置页直接试录一段话，测试麦克风收音并查看毫秒级推理耗时
entries.titleEn: Run a quick mic and recognition test in Settings with millisecond timing feedback
entries.reasonZh: 「在设置页直接试录一段话，测试麦克风收音并查看毫秒级推理耗时」需要你现场开口试录并核对识别文本；智能体会直接定位到语音测试面板交由你体验。
entries.reasonEn: "Run a quick mic and recognition test in Settings with millisecond timing feedback" requires speaking a live test phrase and checking the transcribed output; the Agent opens the Voice diagnostics section for you.

entries.titleZh: 识别完成后将文字放回聊天输入框，方便补充修改后再发送
entries.titleEn: Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending
entries.reasonZh: 「识别完成后将文字放回聊天输入框，方便补充修改后再发送」在当前聊天输入框草稿中直接完成；录音结束后你可自由增删文字或附加文件，满意后再按发送。
entries.reasonEn: "Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending" takes place directly inside your live chat composer draft so you can refine wording or attach files before sending.

entries.titleZh: 显示、隐藏与自由缩放独立桌面伙伴窗口，并可一键唤回主界面
entries.titleEn: Show, hide, and resize the companion window, and return quickly to the main window
entries.reasonZh: 「显示、隐藏与自由缩放独立桌面伙伴窗口，并可一键唤回主界面」涉及你在桌面上直接拖拽缩放悬浮窗尺寸或点击唤回主窗口；智能体可帮你开关伙伴并打开「宠物与助手」设置页。
entries.reasonEn: "Show, hide, and resize the companion window, and return quickly to the main window" involves visual window placement, resizing, and clicking on your desktop; the Agent can toggle the companion or open Pet & assistant settings for you.

entries.titleZh: 在卡片菜单、首页卡片列表或设置里将卡片固定到 Windows 桌面图标层
entries.titleEn: Pin cards to the Windows desktop layer from the card menu, Home list, or Settings
entries.reasonZh: 「在卡片菜单、首页卡片列表或设置里将卡片固定到 Windows 桌面图标层」会将卡片放入 Windows Explorer 桌面层（位于桌面图标之上、应用窗口之下，需 Explorer 可用且 DPI 上下文一致）；这项显示偏好由你在卡片菜单、首页卡片列表或设置页手动切换，智能体可为你直接打开对应管理入口。
entries.reasonEn: "Pin cards to the Windows desktop layer from the card menu, Home list, or Settings" places the card into the Windows Explorer desktop layer (above desktop icons and behind app windows while Explorer is available with a matching DPI context); you toggle this display preference in the card menu, Home list, or Settings while the Agent opens the exact entry.

entries.titleZh: 自由拖拽摆放并拉伸卡片边缘调整尺寸，关闭重启 OpenBitFun 后自动按原样恢复
entries.titleEn: Drag and resize cards freely on screen, with positions and sizes restored on relaunch
entries.reasonZh: 卡片位置由用户在桌面上直接拖动决定，没有可以代替视觉摆放的结构化命令；智能体只说明操作方式，摆放保留给用户。
entries.reasonEn: Card positions are chosen by dragging directly on the desktop, and no structured command can replace that visual placement; the Agent explains the interaction and leaves placement to the user.

entries.titleZh: 在通用页切换简体中文、English 或繁體中文界面语言
entries.titleEn: Switch the UI language among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese in General
entries.reasonZh: “在通用页切换简体中文、English 或繁體中文界面语言”在图形界面中位于“应用与界面 → 通用”顶部下拉框；智能体既可通过语言选项直接修改，也可为你打开通用设置页直观选择。
entries.reasonEn: “Switch the UI language among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese in General” lives at the top of Application & Interface → General in the graphical UI; the Agent can either switch the language option directly or open General settings for visual selection.

entries.titleZh: 手动检查并后台下载更新，确认后安装并重启，或稍后从关于页面安装
entries.titleEn: Check and download updates in the background, then confirm installation and restart or install later from About
